g.text: CampusClaw Backend Logging and Diagnostics Architecture
MDC is not the source of truth after request-thread exit.
The immutable context is passed explicitly to execution and model calls.
If connect or routing fails before CampusClaw,
only the caller can produce the failure log.
No credentials, headers, prompts, message bodies,
thinking, tool arguments, tool results, or raw SSE.
startup.completed is emitted only after all required checks
and the web server binding have succeeded.
Remote model and tool services are lazy runtime dependencies.
